exposure: oxytocin infusion until end of labor
oxytocin infusion discontinued at 5cm cervical dilation
cohort: 132 non-risk laboring mothers at term receiving IV oxytocin for induction or augmentation at a large tertiary maternity care center in West Bengal.
finding: Discontinuing oxytocin infusion during active labor significantly reduced fetal distress, hyperstimulation, emergency caesarean section, and SNCU admission, but prolonged the first stage of labor by approximately one hour.
mod_finding: Emergency Cesarean section rates were 33.3% in the continuous oxytocin group and 9.1% in the discontinued oxytocin group.
